strengths: Explicitly not a law; house rule of a crowded vehicle.
Priority-seat older ‘turn off for medical devices’ vs current stickers: correctly historicized, tells readers to read the car.
Holiday/sports/last-train loudness; manner posters exist because the rule is broken.
Does not invent extra etiquette in women-only cars.

issues.location: Visitor Confusion — ‘You are unlikely to be arrested’ (later: house rule)
issues.problem: Arrest is the wrong legal ceiling for this manners topic; it slightly dramatizes a rule nobody enforces with handcuffs.
issues.suggestion: Staff can ask you to stop; a short call is not a crime. Drop arrest.
